environment.description: Same EC2 instance (m5.large) running identical Flask monolith on port 8080. Security group restricts inbound TCP 8080 to CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing) only. CloudFront distribution configured with Origin Access Control (OAC) using SigV4 signing with custom origin header X-Origin-Verify set to a 64-char random secret validated at ALB level. CloudFront behaviors require signed URLs (Trusted Key Group with RSA-2048 key pair, policy restricts URL path to /api/v1/users/*/profile with GET method only, POST/PUT/PATCH methods excluded from signed URL policy). CloudFront cache behavior for /api/v1/* has allowed-methods set to GET,HEAD only; OPTIONS/PUT/POST/PATCH/DELETE return 403 from CloudFront edge before reaching origin. Viewer protocol policy: HTTPS only.

config.security_group_ingress: TCP 8080 from pl-3b927c52 (CloudFront managed prefix list)
